goal: Make first-admin invitation readiness fail closed unless Supabase Auth is configured with the exact Q-approved manual six-digit code email template.

worktree.rule: No reset, rebase, switch, stash or clean. This worker owns only the two script paths below; documentation remains the onboarding ORCHESTRATOR's later slot.

requiredBehavior: Add one module-private FIRST_ADMIN_INVITE_TEMPLATE constant byte-equal to emailTemplateContract.exactHtml. Do not export a second template source.

Keep createSupabaseAuthAdmin.inviteTtlSeconds as the single Management API GET. After disable_signup === true and integer mailer_otp_exp in 60..604800, require mailer_templates_invite_content === FIRST_ADMIN_INVITE_TEMPLATE.

Missing or non-exact content throws FIRST_ADMIN_INVITE_TEMPLATE_UNREADY before institution creation or invitation submission reaches inviteAuthUser. Do not mutate the hosted template or add a retry/fallback.
Preserve redirect_to as the exact signed clientOrigin /auth/invite, relayerFirstAdmin metadata marker, one-send/resume behavior, TTL, subject/email binding and all existing fixed error redaction.

Update every synthetic successful Auth-config fixture to include the exact template. Add table cases for missing content and one-character variants containing ConfirmationURL, TokenHash, Email, Data, query or fragment additions; each sends zero invitations and returns the fixed unready code.
Keep disable_signup=false and invalid mailer_otp_exp refusals unchanged.
verification: Commit only the two allowed paths with configured hooks. Do not bypass hooks, edit docs, change Auth, access credentials, send an invite, push, merge or deploy.
report: Print marker, parent/commit SHA, exact paths, test counts, zero-send refusal cases, clean state and blockers.
